remarks: Imagine your life in this sophisticated, 18th floor 3-BR, 3.5-bath flat filled w floor-to-ceiling windows so you can enjoy sweeping panoramic vistas of sky, water & city views. The apt. boast high ceilings, marble & wide board wood flrs w/the perfect open floor plan for today AND it will all to be freshly painted & floors refreshed before you move-in! Open design is inviting from the marble foyer into chef's kitchen filled w/Viking stainless appliances incl gas range, loads of cabinetry, lg workspace +very lg center island/breakfast bar complete w wine chiller. Fab flow continues into the open Living & Dining rooms; they're wrapped in glass on 3-sides, so you can see beautiful sunrises AND sunsets w views from LI Sound, across Mill River Park to the NYC skyline PLUS there's a terrace off the LR for outdoor enjoyment. The bedrooms continue to impress-Primary suite is very spacious w rm-sized walk-in closet, stunning marble bath w air jetted tub & walk-in shower+double sink vanity. Lg PBR has a window wall w wonderful views that's an ideal spot for a sitting area. 2-add'l BRs each boast marble en suite & views over Mill River Park. Park Tower offers a full-service luxe lifestyle featuring 24/7-concierge, state-of-the-art fitness center, indoor saltwater pool, screening+ billiards rms & lounge + roof top terrace. Garage parking @extra charges-see Addendum. Live in the heart of Stamford's vibrant downtown-walk to movies, concerts, restaurants & shops. Ultra-Deluxe Living-Must See
